note: Known-conflicting skill libraries, as data. Both plugins/condux/install.mjs and doctor.mjs read this one file — adding an entry is a data edit, not a code edit in two places. Detection is name matching against what is already on disk: no network, no semantic comparison (that is docket #10, an open research question). Every entry must be verified against an installed copy before it ships; a wrong skill name in a shipped warning is worse than no warning.

conflicts.title: superpowers
conflicts.author: obra (Jesse Vincent)
conflicts.verified: 6.2.0, read from an installed copy on 2026-08-11
conflicts.relationship: condux reworks its skill-orchestration ideas around proportional effort — tiered routing, lazy loading, soft gates — rather than always-on maximalism. The debt is real and credited; the consequence is that the two are near-complete functional twins.
conflicts.impact: Both ship a SessionStart hook on the same matcher (startup|clear|compact), and each injects a router telling the agent every dev task starts with it. Whichever is read last wins, per session, unpredictably. 11 of superpowers' 14 skills also overlap 8 of condux's 14, so the agent picks between two competing contracts at every step of a task.
conflicts.recommendation: Run one or the other. They are not layered libraries — they are two answers to the same question.

overlaps.both: the entry-point router — each injected at SessionStart
